senses.gloss:
फ a. Obvious, evident.
 {@फः@}
—1 A high wind, stormy gale.
—2 Yawning with the mouth wide open.
—3 Fruitfulness.
—4 An increaser.
—5 The performance of a mystical rite (to propitiate Kuberaʼs attendants).
—6 Increasing, expanding.
—7 Swelling.
—8 Gain. {@फा@}
—1 Useless or idle speech (n. also).
—2 Heat.
—3 Increase.
—4 An increaser. {@फम्@}
—1 An angry speech.
—2 Blowing into, puffing up.
—3 Bubbling, boiling.

फा m. (Nom. फास्)
—1 Heat.
—2 Idle talk.
